description: NaY₂F₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.61 Å. Y is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.36 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Y atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNaY₃ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Y atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Y atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Y tetrahedra.
